title: Credential at the edges of the input: one-property twin (length)
summary: 4 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 31 vs the 32 characters Datadog's own OpenAPI ApiKey schema fixes (minLength/maxLength 32), length: 35 vs contracted 36, and length: 41 vs the provider-documented maximum of 40 characters. Twin of "Credential at the edges of the input: must be flagged (provider-documented)" and "Credential at the edges of the input: must be flagged (project-policy)".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of bare: length: 35 vs contracted 36. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
